exploration.topic: .env profile switching untuk db_ptrj dan staging database
exploration.scope: 1) DISABLE_STAGING_DB jadi functional, 2) Startup logging profile aktif, 3) DB_PROFILE/DB_EXTEND_PROFILE/DB_STAGING_PROFILE/DB_VENUS_PROFILE/DB_MILL_PROFILE terbaca dari .env dan ditampilkan saat startup

findings.summary: No conditional route mounting pattern exists. DISABLE_STAGING_DB is dead config with zero code references. Startup logging uses raw console.log for only DB_PROFILE+DEFAULT_DATABASE -- missing 4 other profiles. Staging catalog string hardcoded in services, not sourced from Config.

startup_logging.current_output: 4 lines: host:port, run mode, auth mode, DB_PROFILE + DEFAULT_DATABASE
startup_logging.logger_available: utils/logger.ts has info() for structured logging but not used for startup banner
startup_logging.risk_note: ADMIN needs to know which profile each DB targets at startup. Currently only DB_PROFILE shown -- misleading because .env has DB_PROFILE=SERVER_PROFILE_2 but Config defaults to SERVER_PROFILE_1 if .env not read.

route_registration.pattern: Unconditional .use() chaining -- all routes always mounted
route_registration.risk_note: Staging routes always active. If staging DB unreachable, routes respond with 500 at query time -- no graceful disable. No isDev/isProd guard on staging.

conditional_mount.closest_approximation: PROXY_MOUNT boolean in Config (L26) controls whether routes mount under /backend/upah group -- always true when USE_PROXY=true. No DISABLE_STAGING_DB equivalent pattern.

config_loading.pattern: dotenv.config() at module load time with error log on failure

db_client_factory.pattern: Named factory methods wrapping getInstance(database, profile)
db_client_factory.staging_no_disable_check: getStagingInstance() has no disable guard. Always returns live instance.
db_client_factory.hardcoded_catalog: StagingExplorerService L26, StagingComparisonService L5 both hardcode STAGING_CATALOG = 'staging_PTRJ_iFES_Plantware' instead of using Config.DB_STAGING_DATABASE

recommendations.action: Add public static readonly DISABLE_STAGING_DB: boolean = (env.DISABLE_STAGING_DB === true); to config.ts. Key already in .env.
In index.ts wrap both stagingRoutes .use() calls L285 and L310 with if (!Config.DISABLE_STAGING_DB) guard.
Replace console.log block L347-351 with info(Startup ...) calls printing all 5 profiles plus staging disabled status.
Replace hardcoded string in stagingExplorerService.ts L26 and stagingComparisonService.ts L5 with Config.DB_STAGING_DATABASE.
In stagingRoutes.ts delay service singleton init until first route call when staging not disabled.
After dotenv load in config.ts validate critical keys have values and warn on mismatch.
